channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — Cyprus Edition
channel.description: Latest Cyprus business, fintech, compliance and regtech intelligence from BusinessHub.cy.

item.title: EU emissions continue to fall as clean energy gains ground
item.description: EU greenhouse gas emissions dropped by 8% in 2023, driven by a significant shift toward renewable energy and reduced coal reliance across member states.

item.title: Daily news - Nov 8, 2026
item.description: The EU's 2026 climate reports show a 1.6% drop in GHG emissions and an 11% increase in ETS revenues, highlighting the ongoing decoupling of economic growth from carbon emissions.

item.title: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance
item.description: EU authorities invite financial industry stakeholders to join the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) to shape unified standards for tokenised financial ecosystems.

item.title: Gender-smart innovation can strengthen Europe’s economy and competitiveness
item.description: The EIT released a handbook on gender-smart innovation, offering proven strategies to bridge the 80% venture capital funding gap and boost European economic competitiveness.

item.title: Statement on EIT Manufacturing and Support for Beneficiaries
item.description: EIT Manufacturing ASBL has entered judicial liquidation following OLAF investigations, requiring beneficiaries to file claims by mid-August 2026 to recover outstanding funds.

item.title: EIT-supported ventures to feature at the EIC Summit 2026 exhibition
item.description: The EIC Summit 2026 will showcase EIT-supported innovations in renewable energy, circular materials, and AI health, highlighting scaling opportunities for European deep-tech startups.

item.title: EIT Health selected six projects under the EP PerMed Education Call 2025
item.description: EIT Health has selected six innovative projects under the EP PerMed Education Call 2025 to develop specialized training in personalized medicine for healthcare professionals.

item.title: EIT Community brings Europe's innovation ecosystem to Dublin Tech Week
item.description: The EIT Community showcased its 'Knowledge Triangle' model at Dublin Tech Week, emphasizing deep-tech innovation and regional ecosystem support ahead of the Irish EU Council Presidency.

item.title: EIT Health Members Convention 2026 brings together Europe’s health Innovation community
item.description: EIT Health Convention 2026 highlights Europe's biotech and AI health innovation strategies, emphasizing collaborative opportunities for the EU's healthcare and technology ecosystems.

item.title: From ideas to impact: EIT Community New European Bauhaus joins NEB Festival 2026
item.description: The EIT Community joins the 2026 NEB Festival to showcase sustainable innovation, offering Cyprus startups funding opportunities and networking in climate-tech and circular economy sectors.

item.title: EIT Community Hub Bosnia and Herzegovina officially launched in Sarajevo
item.description: The EIT has launched a new Community Hub in Bosnia and Herzegovina to integrate local innovators into the broader European ecosystem, expanding regional R&D and investment opportunities.

item.title: Corporación Hijos de Rivera and EIT Food launch second edition of Impact Sips to accelerate functional beverage innovation
item.description: Corporación Hijos de Rivera and EIT Food launch Impact Sips 2nd edition to scout startups for functional beverage innovation in healthy ageing and mental wellbeing.

item.title: Registration of Motor Vehicles - Total Registrations +8,7% - Jan-Oct 2026
item.description: Motor vehicle registrations in Cyprus rose by 8.7% during the first ten months of 2026, signaling sustained demand in the automotive sector.

item.title: Foreign Trade Statistics - Sep 2026 (Provisional Data) and Aug 2026 (Final Data)
item.description: Cyprus trade deficit widens in late 2026, driven by rising imports and volatile export performance according to latest provisional and final data from Cystat.

item.title: Statement by President von der Leyen following her call with President Zelenskyy and ahead of her visit to the Black Sea Region, in Romania and Bulgaria
item.description: EU President von der Leyen initiates a Black Sea diplomatic mission to address escalating security threats and restore freedom of navigation for food and energy infrastructure.

item.title: Weekly financial statement
item.description: The ECB has adjusted its 2026 weekly financial statement schedule, shifting quarterly publication dates to Wednesdays to accommodate valuation processes.

item.title: Monetary policy decisions
item.description: The European Central Bank outlines its recurring schedule for monetary policy decisions and transparency reporting for the euro area.

item.title: Climate Change Indicators Statistical Release
item.description: The ECB has released updated climate-related statistical indicators to help financial institutions track sustainable finance, carbon emissions, and physical risks across the euro area.

item.title: Bank treasurer survey
item.description: The intended ECB Bank Treasurer Survey page is currently unavailable, resulting in a 404 error and preventing access to critical Eurozone liquidity and funding insights.

item.title: Balance of payments (monthly and quarterly)
item.description: The requested European Central Bank (ECB) statistical page for Balance of Payments data is currently unavailable due to a 404 error.

item.title: €STR Annual Methodology Review
item.description: The ECB released the latest €STR data, confirming a rate of 2.443% based on €67.8 billion in transaction volume across 48 active banks.

item.title: The Minister of Finance of the Republic of Cyprus travels to Brussels for the Eurogroup and ECOFIN meetings of 9 November 2026
item.description: Finance Minister Makis Keravnos attends Eurogroup/ECOFIN to lobby for tax flexibility on energy and discuss the digital euro, banking risks, and tobacco tax reforms.

item.title: The Minister of Finance travels to Brussels for the Eurogroup and ECOFIN Council meetings
item.description: Cyprus Finance Minister Makis Keravnos attends Eurogroup/ECOFIN meetings to lobby for tax relief on heating oil and discuss Eurozone banking stability and digital euro progress.

item.title: LABOUR MARKET INDICATORS
item.description: Cyprus labor market indicators show record-high employment and a significant drop in unemployment, alongside a steady rise in average monthly earnings through 2025 forecasts.

item.title: EIT Culture & Creativity launches €6 million in NEB Academy funding
item.description: EIT Culture & Creativity has launched two calls for proposals totaling €6 million to fund sustainable fashion and urban development education initiatives across Europe.

item.title: Monetary policy decision
item.description: The European Central Bank has released updated interest rate statistics for the Euro area covering the period through September 2026.

item.title: Euro area bank lending survey
item.description: Euro area banks report tightening credit standards and falling loan demand for Q3 2026, while identifying emerging demand for AI-related digital infrastructure financing.

item.title: The ECB Blog
item.description: The ECB warns of rising climate-related financial risks in Europe, calling for enhanced financial protection and a transition to flexible, clean energy systems.

item.title: Working Paper Series
item.description: The European Central Bank has released its latest Working Paper Series, providing foundational research for upcoming monetary policy and economic frameworks.

item.title: Digital Euro Preparation Phase - Progress Report
item.description: The ECB is advancing the digital euro project toward a 2027 pilot and 2029 issuance, aiming to provide a unified European digital payment alternative to international schemes.

item.title: Financial Stability Review
item.description: The ECB's May 2026 Financial Stability Review warns of elevated vulnerabilities due to geoeconomic shocks, private credit stress, and geopolitical instability affecting the euro area.

item.title: Economic Bulletin
item.description: The European Central Bank has released its latest Economic Bulletin, detailing the macroeconomic analysis and projections that inform Eurozone monetary policy decisions.

item.title: Conference on Accounting, Financial Reporting and Corporate Governance
item.description: A high-level conference on Accounting, Financial Reporting, and Corporate Governance has been announced, targeting industry standards and regulatory updates.

item.title: Speech: Press remarks by Executive Vice-President Fitto and Commissioner Tzitzikostas on the EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy
item.description: The European Commission has launched the EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy to coordinate growth, address labor shortages, and distribute economic benefits more widely across territories.

item.title: Speech: Remarks by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the 2026 Enlargement Package
item.description: The EU's 2026 Enlargement Package prioritizes four frontrunners for accession while maintaining a standstill with Turkey and halting Georgia's progress due to democratic backsliding.

item.title: Statement following meeting on prosperity talks today
item.description: International stakeholders met to refine Ukraine's post-war reconstruction framework, emphasizing EU accession reforms as the primary driver for private investment and economic stability.

item.title: Questions and answers on the Education and Skills package
item.description: The European Commission has launched an Education and Skills package to combat declining basic skills, teacher shortages, and digital risks through AI literacy and structural reforms.

item.title: CBC Macroeconomic Forecasts for the Cyprus Economy
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus has released its 2026–2028 macroeconomic forecasts, providing critical projections for GDP growth, inflation, and employment to guide medium-term business planning.

item.title: Statement by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the illegal visit of the Turkish Foreign Minister to the occupied areas
item.description: Cyprus condemns Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan's visit to occupied areas, labeling it a breach of international law and UN resolutions.

item.title: Statement by the Minister of Finance on the upgrade of the Republic of Cyprus by Fitch
item.description: Fitch Ratings has upgraded Cyprus' credit rating to 'A' with a stable outlook, reflecting strong fiscal performance and economic resilience.

item.title: New Call for Proposals for the «Enhancing Cybersecurity for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) designated as Important Entities Falling Within the Scope of the NIS2 Directive» (NCC-CY- NIS2/0826)
item.description: Cyprus launches a €1.53 million funding scheme to help SMEs designated as 'Important Entities' comply with NIS2 cybersecurity standards, offering up to €100,000 per project.

item.title: EIT Governing Board meets in Cyprus to discuss competitiveness, skills and manufacturing innovation
item.description: The EIT Governing Board met in Nicosia to pledge €100 million for manufacturing innovation and discuss strengthening Cyprus's role in the European startup and digital landscape.

item.title: Choose France Summit: Ecolab plans to invest in GravitHy and HoloSolis to support clean reindustrialisation
item.description: Ecolab is investing €100 million in French low-carbon steel and solar gigafactory projects to drive European green reindustrialisation and industrial sustainability.

item.title: EIT Health Catapult 10th Edition – Semifinals
item.description: The EIT Health Catapult 10th edition semifinals have launched, selecting 30 high-potential European Life Science and HealthTech startups for expert mentoring and investor exposure.

item.title: EIT Urban Mobility backs NexDash with €2.5 million to scale electrified freight across Europe
item.description: Berlin-based NexDash secured €2.5M from EIT Urban Mobility to scale its AI-driven electric road freight model across Europe.

item.title: EIT and the Autonomous Region of Sardinia join forces to strengthen innovation and skills development
item.description: The EIT and Sardinia have partnered to integrate the region into European deep-tech and digital innovation ecosystems, focusing on skills development and SME growth.

item.title: Fourteen European cities partner with startups to test innovative mobility solutions through RAPTOR 2026
item.description: Fourteen European cities, including Limassol, are partnering with startups to pilot innovative urban mobility solutions under the RAPTOR 2026 program.

item.title: Startup World Cup Ukraine 2026: EIT Community Hub Ukraine connects founders to Europe and the global stage
item.description: Ukrainian startup Jetbeep wins national Startup World Cup, heading to San Francisco to compete for a $1M prize while strengthening ties with European innovation networks.

item.title: EIT Food selected 65 startups for 2026 FAN programme to accelerate Europe’s innovation
item.description: EIT Food selects 65 startups for its 2026 FAN programme to accelerate agrifood innovation through specialized European hubs and corporate matchmaking.

item.title: EIT Urban Mobility supported project brings innovation procurement solutions to market
item.description: The EIT Urban Mobility-supported IPROMO project has launched new roadmaps and training tools to help public sectors adopt innovation-focused procurement strategies across Europe.
